contracts.docstring: Exact windows recover a final contradiction; unchanged quoted words cannot conceal a different full-file version.
Reviewing commit A cannot publish clean committed B, even in the same unchanged directory identity.
Native completion with an explicit negative review cannot be converted into an effect request using an invented owner acceptance key.
Real kernel/broker/Git/SQLite preserve two tasks plus a shell edit in the final diff, with distinct checks/reviews and explicit unpublished closure; generation and Ken remain controlled.

scope: Changed Python tests and their modules; controlled embedded native edit helper also has an English docstring. Product code unchanged.
